notes: One entry per asset file or pack (SPEC §12.10). `path` is a glob relative to apps/thieves-forum/ (`*` within a folder, `**` across folders); `font` names a Google Fonts family loaded by brand/head.html.

src/__tests__/licenses.test.ts fails if a file under art/ or audio/, or a font, has no entry, or its entry doesn't allow commercial use. Audio entries arrive with the audio delivery (BUILD_PLAN §9 step 7).
